annotations.title: Pikes Peak cost: drive, shuttle or Cog

description: Use this when someone asks what it costs for their group to go up Pikes Peak, or whether driving the Highway, the Highway shuttle or the Cog Railway is cheaper: Highway admission per person or per carload, timed-entry permits, shuttle fares and Cog Railway fares for adults, teens, children and under-6s across one or more vehicles on a date. Uses the official 2026 rate sheets and the railway's online fares. Example questions: "How much is it for 2 adults and 3 kids to drive Pikes Peak?", "Is the Cog Railway or driving cheaper for a family of four?", "Pikes Peak Highway price for 7 people in 2 cars". No tour or hotel prices.

date.description: Date in Colorado: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "tomorrow" (default today).

teens_13_15.description: Aged 13 to 15 (child on the Highway, adult on the Cog).

under_6.description: Aged 5 and under (free on the Highway).
